reason: I don't buy tools off an ad. If a few owners in my peer group said it found real money and their clients didn't walk when they started billing for it, I'd look, but nobody has yet. And I already know we do some free work; that's how we keep clients, so a list of 'leakage' isn't news to me.
objection: Most of what it calls leakage is goodwill I chose to give away, and I'm not uploading contracts and client billing data to a new company with no track record just to be told what I already know. £4k over six months on demo data isn't enough to make me move.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three owners in my peer group showing me their own audit results, with money they actually recovered without losing clients.
